mechanism: Fluphenazine may potentiate gentamicin's ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity through additive effects on the eighth cranial nerve and renal tubules, while gentamicin may increase fluphenazine levels through reduced renal clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, auditory function, and serum gentamicin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; assess baseline and periodic hearing status.
